newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's CNIEC Investment sets US$50 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: China's CNIEC Investment sets US$50 mln loan.

text.p: The following syndicated loan issue was announced by arranger Bankers Trust Co Hong Kong.
BORROWER CNIEC INVESTMENT LTD
GUARANTORS (A) CHINA NATIONAL NONFERROUS METAL INDUSTRY CORP
(CNNC)
(B) CHINA NATIONAL NONFERROUS METALS IMPORT AND
EXPORT CORP (CNIEC)
AMOUNT US$50 MLN TYPE TERM LOAN MATURITY 2 YRS
MARGIN 6ML+50BP REPLIES 25.OCT.96
PUTS NONE CALLS NONE REPAYMENT BULLET
DRAWDOWN 1 LUMP SUM AVAIL 1 MONTH HOME CTRY CHINA
NOTES THERE IS AN ANNUAL SUBSIDY INTEREST PAYMENT OF 55
BASIS POINTS TO BE PROVIDED BY BANKERS TRUST.
THE BORROWER IS INCORPORATED IN HONG KONG.
PROCEEDS OF THE LOAN WILL BE USED FOR GENERAL
WORKING CAPITAL AND FOR REFINANCING EXISTING DEBT.
ARRANGERS BANKERS TRUST CO HONG KONG AND COMMERZ EAST ASIA
MGT LEVELS AND FEES
LEAD MGRS US$5 MLN+ 40BP ALL-IN 125 BP
MANAGERS US$2-4 MLN 30BP ALL-IN 120 BP
-- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6960
